title: Billing Administrator

about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, an established company in Malta's construction and engineering services industry that provides drilling, laboratory testing, surveying and engineering consultancy. The company is looking for a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Billing Administrator to join its team in Mosta.

You will manage customer invoicing from start to finish: checking services, quantities, rates, discounts and taxes, raising invoices in line with customer agreements, processing credit notes and adjustments, and keeping customer accounts and billing records accurate. You will work with the Operations and Administration teams to gather the information needed for each invoice and help follow up on outstanding payments.
The role is full-time and on-site, with a starting gross monthly salary of €1,700 and a structured salary review after six months and again after one year.
responsibilities: Prepare, process and issue customer invoices accurately and within agreed deadlines
Verify billing information, including services provided, quantities, rates, discounts and applicable taxes
Ensure invoices are raised in accordance with customer agreements and internal procedures
Process credit notes, adjustments and other billing documentation when required
Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer accounts and billing records
Liaise with the Operations and Administration teams to obtain the information needed for invoicing
Follow up on outstanding invoices and assist with payment collection where required
Respond to customer queries about invoices, account balances and billing discrepancies
Identify and report billing inconsistencies and make sure they are resolved promptly
Carry out additional administrative duties as assigned by the Operations Manager
requirements: Previous experience in billing, invoicing, accounts administration or a similar administrative role
Good numerical skills and strong attention to detail
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
Ability to maintain accurate records and handle financial documentation
Strong organisational and time management skills
Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and prioritise tasks effectively
A responsible, proactive and team-oriented approach
offer: Salary review after six months of continuous employment, with a possible increase to €1,800 gross per month (subject to performance, business conditions and mutual agreement)
Possible further increase to €1,900 gross per month after one year of continuous employment (subject to performance, the employer's discretion and mutual agreement)
Salary paid monthly in arrears, on the last Friday of each month
The opportunity to develop your experience within an established engineering services company
A varied administrative role involving coordination with different departments
A professional and supportive working environment
languages: English — working language for invoicing and customer queries
